concept: The morning batch: the shop is defined by two acts it states itself, tsubu-an cooked every morning and each sweet wrapped one at a time, and by the one item that carries them, the dorayaki.

css_notes: Everything in the page is reachable with the current allowlist: grid, hairline borders, a framed image slot with object-fit, solid colour bands, horizontal Mincho and Gothic.
Not reproducible today and refused in the prompt: text over the image, gradients, drop shadows, textures, vertical text, fixed headers.
If the comp shows any of these anyway, the implementation records the gap instead of changing the allowlist.
